draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.28, the 50th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 8th of 37 at CB. He went 71st overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Steven Nelson. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (83rd percentile). College production: 6 passes defended in 2020, 12th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2022. 11 career games and 4 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2021. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (17th percentile). Played 2 of 17 games in 2022.
